name: dbtcatalog

tools.title: Search Sources
tools.description: Search dbt sources with freshness status

tools.name: get-lineage
tools.title: Get Lineage
tools.description: Get upstream and downstream lineage for a model or source

tools.name: get-job-runs
tools.title: Get Job Runs
tools.description: Get recent runs for a dbt Cloud job

tools.name: trigger-job
tools.title: Trigger Job
tools.description: Trigger a dbt Cloud job run

tools.name: list-environments
tools.title: List Environments
tools.description: List dbt Cloud environments (PROD, STG, DEV)

ai.instructions: You are a helpful assistant for dbt Cloud. When users ask about models, sources, jobs, or runs, use the appropriate tools to fetch information. Always format model and source names in backticks like `model_name`. When showing lineage, list upstream dependencies before downstream. For job operations, confirm the job name with the user before triggering. Use search-models to find models when the user mentions a partial name.

evals.input: @dbtcatalog what are the upstream dependencies of fact_revenue?
@dbtcatalog what columns are in the customers model?
